# spatial-cad-mcp

> Modular, deterministic MCP servers for CAD / BIM / GIS / HDM / mesh workflows, built for AI-to-AI use. Pre-alpha monorepo: `mcp-ifc` (Python, ifcopenshell) and `mcp-dxf`, `mcp-gis`, `mcp-hdm`, `mcp-mesh` (pure Rust, rmcp), plus the `cadctl` CLI. One JSON envelope contract, one workspace sandbox (`MCP_CAD_WORKSPACE_ROOT`).

## Agent entry points

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) - the agent contract: setup, data policy, envelope, rules, tool index, commit conventions
- [docs/index.md](docs/index.md) - documentation map: area -> guide -> package -> tests
- [docs/onboarding.md](docs/onboarding.md) - canonical onboarding and the check commands
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) - picking up work and opening a PR
